blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan – Urdaneta City in Pangasinan has declared alternate work arrangements (work from home) on Friday (Oct. 2) for all teachers in the city in observance of the Family Day and National Teachers Day 2026. Executive Order No 23 issued on Thursday (Oct. 1) by Mayor Julius Parayno says since Monday next week (Oct. 5) is the culmination of the National Teachers Month and World Teachers Day, it would be best to grant them alternate work arrangement on Friday in preparation for weekend rest day. “It is but fitting to give the teachers time to celebrate their achievements with their […]...
